headline: Maui County Board of Variances & Appeals

meeting.body: Maui County Board of Variances & Appeals
meeting.summary: The board approved its 2025 meeting schedule.
meeting.recap: The board approved its 2025 meeting schedule.[[0:04:04]] Two property owners asked for a declaratory ruling (a formal answer on how a law applies) about an hours limit on their property.[[0:04:45]] The owners' attorney said the home burned in the fire and the owners want to rebuild.[[1:09:32]] The county's attorney said vacation rentals are not an allowed use there.[[2:12:25]] A motion saying condition 8 does not cover overnight residential-type use failed with three votes in favor.[[2:44:45]] A motion to deny the petition as outside the board's authority got four votes, short of a majority.[[2:47:41]] The owners' attorney agreed to write up the board's decision and order.[[3:16:43]] The next meeting is January 9, 2025.[[3:17:31]]
decided: A motion saying condition 8 does not apply to overnight residential-type use did not pass.
A motion to deny the petition as outside the board's authority did not get a majority.

moments.q: "the hours of operation for all uses shall be limited to 7 a. until 900 p.m."
Owners' attorney: the property burned down in the fire
County's attorney presents the county's case
"we still do not have a majority here"
